prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ formatWorkshop }`. `formatWorkshop(workshop)` accepts an object with exactly the relevant fields `title`, `seats`, and `topics`; unrelated fields may be ignored. `title` must be a string containing at least one non-whitespace character. `seats` must be an integer from 0 through 10000. `topics` must be an array of strings, each containing at least one non-whitespace character. Invalid input must throw `TypeError`, except an out-of-range integer seat count must throw `RangeError`. Return `{ heading, topics }`, where `heading` is the trimmed title followed by ` (N seats)`, and `topics` contains trimmed topic strings. An empty topic array is valid. Preserve topic order and duplicates. Do not mutate the input object or array, and return a new topic array.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
